an3.128:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane Migadāye.
an3.128:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Bārāṇasiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an3.128:1.3: Addasā kho Bhagavā Goyogapilakkhasmiṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ rittassādaṃ bāhirassādaṃ sammuṭṭhassatiṃ asampajānaṃ asamāhitaṃ vibbhantacittaṃ pākatindriyaṃ.
an3.128:1.4: Disvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:-- Bhikkhu bhikkhu
an3.128:2.1: mā kho tvaṃ attānaṃ kaṭuviyam akāsi.
an3.128:2.2: Taṃ vata bhikkhu kaṭuviyakataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti nānvassavissantī ti n' etaṃ thānaṃ vijjatī ti. 2.
an3.128:2.3: Atha kho so bhikkhu Bhagavatā iminā ovādena ovadito saṃvegaṃ āpādi.
an3.128:2.4: Atha kho Bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapāta-paṭikkanto bhikkhū āmantesi:
an3.128:3.1: Idhāhaṃ bhikkhave pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Bārāṇasiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
an3.128:3.2: Addasaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave Goyogapilakkhasmiṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ rittassādaṃ bāhirassādaṃ sammuṭṭhassatiṃ asampajānaṃ asamāhitaṃ vibbhantacittaṃ pākatindriyaṃ.
an3.128:3.3: Disvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:. Bhikkhu bhikkhu
an3.128:4.1: mā kho tvaṃ attānaṃ kaṭuviyam akāsi.
an3.128:4.2: Taṃ vata bhikkhu kaṭuviyakataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti nānvassavissantī ti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī ti.
an3.128:4.3: Atha kho bhikkhave so bhikkhu mayā iminā ovādena ovadito saṃvegaṃ āpādī ti. 3.
an3.128:4.4: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an3.128:5.4: Taṃ vata bhikkhu kaṭuviyakataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti nānvassavissantī ti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī ti.
